## Workload

Priya Anand completed grading activity across the review period, reading 807 submissions in 366 hours. This represents an average throughput of 2.2 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review of both activity levels and the consistency of grading practice. The reported hours provide the basis for the throughput calculation and support comparison of work completed during the period.

## Quality

A sample of 66 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement level was 81.8 per cent. This result indicates the extent to which the reviewed grading decisions matched the agreed assessment standard. The check also provided an opportunity to identify cases requiring closer consideration, including borderline background cases. Feedback was provided on those cases to support consistent decisions and ongoing quality improvement.

The grader and reviewer were both Priya Anand.
